correctness.rationale: The finite CW complex has exactly 4554 dihedral cell orbits in dimensions zero to five, each orbit size ten because the group acts freely on every cell. Signed oriented quotient boundaries use only exact integers and square to zero. Integral unit-pivot Schur eliminations give Smith invariants B1=(1^101), B2=(1^468,2), B3=(1^831), B4=(1^667,5), B5=(1^206,2). The remaining blocks are checked exactly to be zero or rank one with all nonzero entries of equal absolute value. These determine H0=Z, H1=Z/2, H2=0, H3=Z plus Z/5, H4=Z/2 and higher zero. The standalone verifier enumerates all cells and replays every computation with integer arithmetic; no extrapolation to untested infinite cases.
